$comment: The engines the interface can choose between. ESCAP requires two that differ in kind, at least one open-weights, declared before 30 September and unchanged after.

engines.label: Engine A
engines.weaknesses: Quantised to 4 bits. Reads a long provision in one pass at 16k context; a longer section is split, and a definition that sits outside the split is not seen.
engines.notes: Every run recorded so far was answered by this engine.

engines.label: Engine B
engines.notes: Not declared yet. The interface offers it once a provider, model and exact checkpoint are filled in here.
